issues.title: Ingest Izard County’s 2026 budget
issues.detail: The county’s 2026 budget as filed with the state (artransparency.gov, May 2026), turned into a money trail with a page cite on every amount.

stamped.revealed: $9,170,289 across 27 funds. The largest: County General ($3,632,298), Road Fund ($2,393,438), Jail Operation Fund ($1,120,414). Every total marked complete adds to its parts to the cent; where the county’s own pages disagree, the page keeps the printed number and an open question below.

issues.title: Get the adopted 2026 appropriation ordinance
issues.detail: The filing’s 2026 column is labeled “Requested” and it has no appropriation ordinance. Ask the county clerk for the ordinance the quorum court adopted, and check these amounts against it.

issues.title: Reconcile Emergency 911
issues.detail: Printed total is $349,001.00; the parts listed add to $350,001.00. Ask the county treasurer or clerk which figure is right, and how the adopted amount splits.
